new_certificate.title: ha-certbot
new_certificate.description: Describe the certificate you want to issue.

data_description.domains: Comma separated; wildcards are allowed. The first domain names the certificate.
data_description.acme_server_url: Only used for Custom. Must be an HTTPS URL without user credentials or a fragment.

migrate.title: Import an old configuration
migrate.description: Disable the old entry first. Import copies its configuration and eligible account/certificate files without deleting the originals. Old shared certificates with ambiguous CA ownership are retained but not imported. Update HTTPS paths and automations after verifying the new entry.

credentials.title: DNS credentials

data_description.eab_kid: Required by ZeroSSL, Google Trust Services and SSL.com
data_description.eab_hmac_key: Required by ZeroSSL, Google Trust Services and SSL.com
